title: Secret-like values are present in tracked material
plain: A secret-like value appears in tracked Atlas material; if real, it could expose a service or private data.
verify_by: Inspect flagged values without exposing them and confirm they are synthetic or remove and rotate any real credential.
owner_action: Confirm whether any flagged value is real and rotate it outside Atlas if so.
stopgap: Do not use any flagged credential; revoke it if it is real.
evidence: Secret-shaped values were found in a work-log test and two fixtures; the source path needs confirmation that values are synthetic.
correction: Remove any real credential, replace fixtures with placeholders, and add a scan gate.
test_plan: Run the secret scan after replacement and confirm no usable credential remains.
control: Secrets must not be committed or retained in logs.

title: Mobile registration accepts a caller-provided web address
plain: A mobile setup helper may contact an address supplied by the caller, exposing a private service or credentials.
verify_by: Run it with an untrusted address and confirm it is rejected or limited to Apple hosts.
evidence: Both helpers build requests from a caller-provided path or address; allowed host and redirect rules need confirmation.
correction: Allow only fixed Apple hosts and reject absolute addresses before requests.
test_plan: Test allowed Apple paths and rejected private or external addresses.

title: Generated command documentation may use stale state
plain: The command reference may describe earlier settings, so Atlas can appear to support a command that no longer works.
verify_by: Change one command entry, regenerate, and confirm the new wording appears.
evidence: The generator carries pending entries while reading the catalog; a flagged state pattern needs a focused regeneration check.
correction: Reload the working entry at each boundary and add a regeneration check.
test_plan: Regenerate after a temporary catalog change and compare output.
